The file GJC;TTYRD >
shows a bug in read. The SFA does rubout-processing by
using a *THROW. After that, TYI behaves strangely.
Do (tty-read)(this is a [bug<rubout>]
to get the bug. ( "[" has been set up as a read macro
character).

(this bug is in the interpreted version, but not the
compiled one, however, sharpm is broken in either case by
the *throw).
